[01] BREAKING AWAY FROM THE PREDICTABLE.
Rejecting commercial club formulas, VIP divisions, and predictable playlists.

Curating fast, dark, groove-laden rhythms with absolute sound system integrity.

Forward-leaning electronic sound. Leave your ego outside the door.

THE DANCEFLOOR CODE // RUPTURE ETHICS.

Our events are built on a strict collective agreement:

[01] NO PHONES. NO CAMERAS.
Keep your phone in your pocket. Live the moment directly with the crowd. Anyone filming on the dancefloor will have their camera stickered or be escorted out.

[02] ZERO TOLERANCE FOR HARASSMENT.
No racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, or non-consensual contact. If anyone crosses your boundary, notify security or our Safer Space monitors immediately.

[03] BODILY AUTONOMY & MUTUAL CONSENT.
Wear what you want or what makes you feel free. Respect other people's space and personal expression.

[04] COME FOR THE SOUND. LEAVE YOUR EGO OUTSIDE.
No VIP tables. No backstage elitism. We are all equal on the concrete floor.
